Team / Acme,

We are entering the final 72 hours of the quarter. Finance needs a locked forecast by end-of-day Thursday. I ran a quick filter of our top-20 ACV opportunities for Acme and flagged items that still need owner confirmation or stage adjustment. Please do the following before EOD Wednesday: 

- Owners: update HubSpot stage to the best *current* state (Proposal, Legal, PO, Lost) — do not leave "Commit" if there is no signed PO.
- If you intend to keep an opportunity in the committed number, reply in-thread with the precise close date and counterparty (PO/contract) you expect.
- If there is risk, mark as "At-risk" and add short reason (procurement delay / legal redlines / pricing ask).

Attached is EOQ_top20_snapshot.csv with the rows I highlighted in yellow. I pasted the 7 items that are ambiguous below with current owners:

1) ACME-42 — Owner: Lauren B. — Stage: Proposal (awaiting SOW)
2) ACME-39 — Owner: Marissa C. — Stage: Contract (price redline)
3) ACME-35 — Owner: Jonas W. — Stage: Demo/PO (legal loop)
4) ACME-31 — Owner: Ben C. — Stage: Commit (no PO yet)
5) ACME-27 — Owner: Marissa C. — Stage: Negotiation (discount request)
6) ACME-22 — Owner: Lauren B. — Stage: Legal (SLA question)
7) ACME-18 — Owner: Jonas W. — Stage: Lost (reprice required)

Finance will treat anything without a signed PO/contract as non-committed. If you have a signed document in process, upload it to the shared Drive and paste the link here. I will reconcile counts on Thursday morning and will publish the locked totals at 09:00 PST.

Ben
